expectations.text: Performs a structured review before discussing implementation
expectations.evidence: Full structured review in Step 2 with completeness/feasibility/alignment sections and checkboxes, followed by handoff in Step 4.

expectations.text: Calibrates review expectations to quick mode (doesn't penalize for missing red team analysis)
expectations.evidence: Explicitly states: 'I would not penalize the spec for lacking multi-perspective drafts or red team analysis, since quick mode is designed for simpler issues.' Notes red team absence as 'informational, not a deficiency.'

expectations.text: After review, shows the user the handoff commands (acorn approve, dev wt, dev pi)
expectations.evidence: Shows all three commands: 'acorn approve candles rate-limiting', 'dev wt candles rate-limiting', 'dev candles/rate-limiting/pi' with explanations of each.

expectations.text: Includes the spec path so the implementer knows where to find it
expectations.evidence: Agent instruction includes: 'Read the implementation spec at ~/Projects/candles/main/.specs/rate-limiting/plans/SPEC.md'

expectations.text: Lets the user control the handoff pace — doesn't auto-run commands
expectations.evidence: Ends with 'Want me to run any of these steps?' — presents commands for the user to drive, doesn't auto-execute.

expectations.text: Includes review notes or implementation guidance for the agent
expectations.evidence: Three specific implementation notes bridging review gaps: (1) use existing error envelope pattern for 429s, (2) add concurrent request tests and Redis failover tests, (3) verify Redis client/pool accessibility from middleware.

expectations.text: Mentions how to check agent progress (dev pi-status)
expectations.evidence: Shows: 'dev pi-status candles/rate-limiting --messages 1' under the Monitor progress section.
